extraction.pages_processed: 2-128 (full report read via the table of contents and keyword search; Chapter 2 material on pages 77, 79-80; Chapter 10 on pages 90-92)
extraction.notes: Whole report screened: Chapter 2 (cluster 2 summary page 77 and chapter section pages 79-80) extracted in full; every other section searched for passages that materially concern the technology theme, using the table of contents and keyword searches, with surrounding text read in context. Period covered taken from footnote 1 of the report (June 2022 to June 2023); the register leaves it blank. Claims repeated between the report summary and the chapter sections are extracted at each place (R10). Chapter 2 contains no technology element (no reference to EESSI or other electronic systems). Figures for online public services differ within the report (238 on page 81, 392 on page 91, 230 on page 122) and household internet access differs between page 66 (83.6%) and the annex (83.7). Revised on 2026-10-29 under extraction rules 0.2 (R1 to R11): items failing the narrower materiality test, digital skills items, a Chapter 2 item outside the run-record boundary and list lead-ins were removed, repeated claims were added at each place, page-break quotes were restored, and three 0.1b quotes that had started too early were corrected. Second revision on 2026-10-29 under extraction rules 0.3 (R12 to R20): e-procurement, tax e-services and the agricultural e-application were treated as digital government and restored, the Chapter 2 integrity recommendation and two lead-ins with their own claim were restored, and no other item needed change. G3 independent review applied routine fixes (see review/RUN-2026-01/g3_qa/). Finalised on 29 October 2026 under extraction rules 0.4 and themes 1.3: the customs IT systems progress finding (-0170) was removed under R22, the metric -0070 and the intervention -0093 were split under R23 into new findings -0210 and -0211, -0043 was flagged theme_doubtful under R21, and the cybercrime, customs, freight information and agricultural IT misses from the G3 review were not added (R21, R22). Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
